## Project: Instagram Clone

Full-stack social media application with React frontend, Node.js backend, MongoDB database, real-time features, image/video upload, stories, posts, likes, comments, follow system, and user authentication.

### Quick Start

1. Install MongoDB and ensure it's running
2. Set up Cloudinary account and update backend/.env with credentials
3. Run `npm run dev` to start both servers
4. Frontend: http://localhost:3000
5. Backend API: http://localhost:5000
